description: This file contains utility functions related to handling currency conversions and saving data within the SuiteCRM framework, specifically for the AOS_Products_Quotes module.

methods.name: perform_aos_save
methods.description: Saves currency conversions for focus object, updating dollar amounts based on currency conversion rates.

methods.name: fetch_aos_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency bean associated with the focus object, logging a warning if currency_id is not set.

methods.name: amountToConvertIsDatabaseValue
methods.description: Checks if the current amount value matches the fetched database value for a specific field.
